title: Add IPC and HTTP protocol version negotiation
summary: Add a stable protocol-info response over unauthenticated IPC and HTTP so clients can detect wire compatibility before attempting privileged calls.
expectedFailureModes: Clients must guess compatibility from daemon behavior because there is no version endpoint.
IPC version probing is incorrectly treated as an authentication failure.
HTTP exposes health but not protocol compatibility metadata.
Docs describe version negotiation before code and tests exist.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant-ipc protocol_info --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd protocol_info --locked
nextAction: Integrated locally; add stale-client compatibility fixtures when protocol version 2 introduces schema migration pressure.
